question.en: Was Mrs. Rumbold a good companion at dinner?
question.zh: 兰博尔德夫人是饭桌上的好同伴吗？

sentences.en: Was Mrs. Rumbold a good companion at dinner?
sentences.zh: 兰博尔德夫人是饭桌上的好同伴吗？

sentences.en: Last week at a dinner party, the hostess asked me to sit next to Mrs. Rumbold.
sentences.zh: 上星期在一次宴会上，女主人要我坐在兰博尔德夫人旁边。

sentences.en: Mrs. Rumbold was a large, unsmiling lady in a tight black dress.
sentences.zh: 兰博尔德夫人是一位身材高大、不苟言笑的女人，穿着一件紧身黑裙。

sentences.en: She did not even look up when I took my seat beside her.
sentences.zh: 当我在她身旁坐下时，她甚至连头都没抬。

chunks.x: when I took my seat beside her

sentences.en: Her eyes were fixed on her plate and in a short time, she was busy eating.
sentences.zh: 她的眼睛盯着盘子，不一会儿就忙着吃起来。

sentences.en: 'A new play is coming to "The Globe" soon,' I said.  'Will you be seeing it? '
sentences.zh: “一出新戏很快就要在‘环球剧场’上演，”我说，“您去看吗？”

chunks.x: A new play is coming to The Globe soon

sentences.en: 'Will you be spending your holidays abroad this year? ' I asked.
sentences.zh: “您今年要到国外度假吗？”我问。

chunks.x: Will be spending holidays abroad year

sentences.en: 'Will you be staying in England? ' I asked.
In despair, I asked her whether she was enjoying her dinner.
sentences.zh: 失望之中，我问她这顿饭是否吃得满意。

sentences.en: 'Young man,' she answered,'if you ate more and talked less, we would both enjoy our dinner!'
sentences.zh: “年轻人，”她回答说，“如果你多吃点、少说点，我们俩都会吃得开心！”
